name: unboundmark
description: Find, read, and update notes, board cards, and calendar events, and upload files, in your connected UnboundMark workspace.

interface.longDescription: Connect your UnboundMark account to find and summarize notes, create Markdown documents, update board cards, manage calendar events, and attach files to notes, folders, and cards. The plugin accesses only resources available to your connected account. Shared workspace roles and document versions apply to every change. Uploads follow the same file size and storage limits as the UnboundMark app. An UnboundMark account with MCP access is required. Deletion moves documents and empty folders to trash; permanent deletion and trash restoration are unavailable through this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find my project notes and summarize the next steps.
Create a Markdown note from these meeting decisions.
Show the open tasks on my project board.

review.commerce_description: Users manage documents in their existing UnboundMark workspace. The plugin has no commerce operations.

positive.description: Find a note and summarize facts from its content.
positive.prompt: Find the Release Plan note in my Review Workspace folder. Summarize its decisions and next steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the matching note. Report the October 22 release, Markdown export, the export verification task, and the support guide task. Identify the source document. Do not invent owners or deadlines.

positive.description: Create a Markdown note in the requested folder.
positive.prompt: Create a note named Review Meeting in Review Workspace. Record that we approved Markdown export and need to verify exports.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Review Workspace. Create one text document in that folder. Read it back and confirm both supplied facts. Reuse the returned ID. Do not create an unrelated folder.

positive.description: Apply an exact edit without overwriting unrelated note content.
positive.prompt: In Release Plan, change the release date from October 22, 2026 to October 23, 2026. Keep everything else.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the note and its revision. Apply one exact edit with baseRevision. Read it back. Only the release date changes. A repeated request must not create another note or erase the action list.

positive.description: Move one board card and preserve its description and tags.
positive.prompt: Move Verify export on Review Board from Todo to Done. Keep its description and tags.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the board outline, Todo column, and Verify export card. Move that card using its cardVersion and the observed Done column ID. Read it back. Preserve the description and export tag. Other cards stay in their columns.

positive.description: Change one local event using the observed event version.
positive.prompt: Move Review Demo in Review Calendar on October 22, 2026 from 14:00–15:00 to 15:00–16:00. Keep its date and description.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the calendar month and the local event. Use its eventVersion to update the start and end times. Read it back. Preserve the date and description. Do not create a duplicate event.

positive.description: Attach a small text file to a note.
positive.prompt: Attach a text file named export-check.txt to the Release Plan note. Its content is: Markdown export verified.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Release Plan note. Upload one inline file with add_attachment using parentType document and the note ID. Report the stored filename, size, and link. Do not change the note text or upload any other file.

positive.description: Attach a small text file to one board card.
positive.prompt: Attach a text file named export-steps.txt to the Verify export card on Review Board. Its content is: Open the note, export Markdown, compare the file.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the board and the Verify export card with its cardVersion. Upload one inline file with add_attachment using documentId and cardId. Read the card attachments back. Keep the card in its column with its description and tags.

negative.description: Prevent access outside the connected account and share permissions.
negative.prompt: Read the private documents of another UnboundMark user who has not shared them with me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connected account cannot access those documents. Do not claim to have read them or attempt to change permissions.
Explain that permanent deletion is unavailable through the plugin. Do not call delete_document, delete_folder, or another write tool as a substitute.

negative.description: Clarify an ambiguous board card before changing data.
negative.prompt: Move Review the plan on Review Board to Done.
negative.expected_behavior: Read the board and find two cards with that title. Ask which card to move. Do not update either card before the user identifies the target.

publication.release_notes: Added file uploads to notes, folders, and board cards with the add_attachment tool and the attachments.write permission. Uploads follow the same limits as the UnboundMark app.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gerencie notas e tarefas
pt-BR.description: Conecte sua conta do UnboundMark para buscar e resumir notas, criar documentos Markdown, atualizar cartões, gerenciar eventos e anexar arquivos a notas, pastas e cartões. O plugin acessa somente os recursos permitidos para sua conta. As permissões de compartilhamento e as versões dos documentos protegem as alterações. Os envios seguem os mesmos limites de tamanho e armazenamento do aplicativo. Requer uma conta com acesso ao MCP. A exclusão move documentos e pastas vazias para a lixeira. A exclusão permanente e a restauração pela lixeira não estão disponíveis pelo plugin.

es-419.subtitle: Gestiona notas y tareas
es-419.description: Conecta tu cuenta de UnboundMark para buscar y resumir notas, crear documentos Markdown, actualizar tarjetas, gestionar eventos y adjuntar archivos a notas, carpetas y tarjetas. El plugin solo accede a los recursos permitidos para tu cuenta. Los permisos compartidos y las versiones de los documentos protegen los cambios. Las cargas siguen los mismos límites de tamaño y almacenamiento de la aplicación. Requiere una cuenta con acceso al MCP. La eliminación mueve documentos y carpetas vacías a la papelera. La eliminación permanente y la restauración desde la papelera no están disponibles mediante el plugin.
